description: REVIEWED exclusions from the alpha158 panel training universe (renquant_orchestrator.retrain_alpha158_fund). A name listed here is removed from the universe BEFORE the OHLCV refresh, the freshness guard AND the panel build (the guard hands base-data's panel build a filtered inventory). Every entry needs a reason from {delisted, merged, symbol_change, data_outage_confirmed}, an ISO effective_date, an http(s) evidence_url and the PR that added it; the retrainer refuses to run on a missing or schema-invalid registry. A stale name that is NOT listed here vetoes the retrain — that veto is the reminder to add a reviewed entry (with evidence) or to fix ingestion. Remove an entry once the versioned inventory (base-data) itself prunes the name.
